response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node, testing craftsmanship, open-source leadership, and public speaking/mentoring), which maps well to the customer-facing technical-leadership and engineering-excellence aspects of the role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI solutions is not met: AI-related work appears limited to roughly one year at re:cinq on MCP code generators and agent tooling. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases, no RAG architectures, no multi-agent frameworks, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only modest cloud depth (AWS CDK). Worth a screening call given the MCP/agentic exposure and strong engineering fundamentals, but he is well below the stated AI bar for a Staff GenAI FDE.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems across web, backend, mobile, and embedded; strong TypeScript/Node depth
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience, directly relevant to a key listed technology
Proven mentorship, workshops, conference talks, and open-source founding — fits technical-leadership expectations
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-focused work versus the required 8+ years of production AI solutions
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework experience
Python absent from skills; cloud/data-pipeline experience is limited and not AI-specific

key_factors.factor: AI experience depth vs. 8+ year requirement
Missing RAG / vector DB / LLM evaluation expertise
Staff-level engineering breadth, MCP/agent tooling, and mentorship track record
